note: This file is a pure configuration/constants module with no functions, classes, or callable APIs. It defines module-level variables used to configure deterministic puppet agent tests in the Concordia pub coordination game.
configure_puppet_test: configure a minimal deterministic puppet agent test with fixed player names and pub preferences
set_player_preferences: set PERSON_PREFERENCES to map each player name to their favorite pub for deterministic testing
define_venue_preferences: define VENUE_PREFERENCES as a dict mapping pub names to their descriptions
customize_scenario_premise: customize SCENARIO_PREMISE to set the year, location, and event context for puppet agents
set_call_to_decision: set CALL_TO_DECISION to specify the question puppet agents should answer about pub choice
